turns.text: All good here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My work gave me a budget of fifteen hundred for a new laptop.

turns.text: Yeah, and run lots of virtual machines.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold up, my mom is asking me something. Please don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did we ever buy wrapping paper?

turns.speaker: friend

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's not going to be enough for all of these.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Kitchen drawer, next to the scissors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Marcus, can you reach that box on the top shelf?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Barely, hold on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, what were you saying?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right. The work budget. Laptop only, or laptop plus monitor?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All on the laptop. I already have a monitor.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, go for thirty two gigs of memory and a fast drive.
